newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA - RADIO NOON HEADLINES - MAY 12.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA - RADIO NOON HEADLINES - MAY 12.

text.p: These were the main headlines reported by Kuku Radio on Monday at noon. Reuters has not verified these reports and cannot vouch for their accuracy.
- The prime minister's advisor said control over monopolies should be tightened in order to curb the rise in consumer prices.
- Teachers from four counties went on strike today to demand higher wages.
